results.title: Tech selloff weighs down Wall St as bond yields climb
results.description: Wall Street's main indices closed lower on Tuesday with semiconductors leading technology declines as Middle East uncertainty pushed bond yields to multiyear peaks, feeding concerns about borrowing costs and inflation.

results.description: The post Costa Rica Promotes the “Wellness Pura Vida” Strategy for Reconnection and Longevity Tourism appeared first on The Costa Rica News . In an effort to solidify its status as the world’s premier destination for holistic well-being, Costa Rica has launched its “Wellness Pura Vida” strategy. This initiative responds to the growing global demand for purposeful travel by promoting experiences centered on nature reconnection, mental health care, and active longevity across the country’s ecological sanctuaries.
